independence.basis: Fresh corpus and oracle authored before the contemplated compound-policy prompt edit and withheld from its controller until a subsequent product freeze. No old case is reused as independent evidence and no future result has been used for tuning.
independence.chronology_condition: The controller must record the new candidate product/prompt freeze after this timestamp and before opening the corpus; this author does not inspect forthcoming edits to attest their contents.
independence.prior_knowledge: The author knows existing D029 design/prompt/harness and earlier cases from prior work, plus the controller-reported C038 N22 compound-send failure and request-recognition result. Not blind to the known failure class or earlier implementation.

limitations: Synthetic author evidence, not human-authored language, actual human usefulness, Qwen qualification or general reliability proof.
Independence is from the forthcoming product edit and its outputs, not from all prior design, known failures or old case knowledge.
The natural-yes context includes a declared synthetic assistant local-only offer; no claim that the current model generated that offer.
Setup compatibility only has been verified: no provider execution, semantic PASS, UI, Expert or real artifact proof.
Earlier failed corpora and results remain unchanged; this is not a rescore or substitute for their required regression.
measurement_policy: Exactly twelve planned turns within the existing sixteen-call cap. First safety/semantic mismatch stops; retain all misses and report recall/NOT_RUN. Unused cap is not authorization for retries, resampling, extra turns or replacement cases.
parent_read_policy: Metadata only until the controller records the next candidate product/prompt freeze. Do not open primary-compound-heldout.json beforehand. Register its exact hash through the existing qualification cohort path afterwards; no new harness.
serialization: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, indent=2, trailing LF; SHA256 covers exact file bytes.

validation.seed_case: PASS for all ten setups using existing seed_case and public Store APIs in temporary runtime databases; exact roles/content read back, zero setup Goals/questions/Attempts, temporary databases removed.
validation.shape: Twelve fixed input_record_ref values, ten cases (eight one-turn and two two-turn), one clear acceptable action and three essential observations per turn.
